sections.label: Upload Settings
sections.help: Which systems DCS-DTC types into the cockpit when uploading. Order: waypoints (CDU), then radios (ARC-210 via the left MFCD COMM page). The page re-creates a null system.

sections.label: Waypoints
sections.help: CDU waypoint database (sequence 1..200). Filled from the dashboard route. The page re-creates a null system, but a null Waypoints.Waypoints list crashes it.

sections.label: Capture Settings
sections.help: Where points captured on the DCS F10 map (Ctrl+Shift+D dialog) are inserted into the waypoint list. App-side only, never uploaded. The page re-creates a null system.

sections.label: Radios
sections.help: ARC-210 (Radio1, "UHF/VHF/FM", 30 presets). Radio2 is hidden in the UI and never uploaded but is still serialised: keep it as a default radio. The page re-creates a null system; Radio1/Radio2 must not be null.

fields.label: Aircraft code
fields.help: Always "A10". The loader picks the C# configuration type from this value; it must match the preset folder / Load page.

fields.label: Format version
fields.help: Always 2. A missing Version (or 1) together with a missing Upload sends the file to the V1 converter, which throws for this aircraft.

fields.label: Kneeboard notes
fields.help: Free text shown (and editable) in the in-game DCS-DTC kneeboard dialog (Ctrl+Shift+K). Not a system: Load/Save never copies it, only a whole preset file carries it.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Type the waypoint list into the CDU (WP page, L/L entry).

fields.label: Radios
fields.help: Program ARC-210 presets and select the manual frequency / preset (Radio1 only).

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: Filled from the planned route: route point i -> Sequence i (1..N, contiguous, list sorted by Sequence). The uploader walks the list in order and first sets the CDU waypoint quantity to the highest Sequence, so gaps create empty CDU waypoints. Max 200.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: CDU waypoint number (1..200, unique). Use 1..N in route order.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Required (non-empty). The uploader types the first 12 characters on the CDU; only A-Z, 0-9, ".", ",", "/" and space are typed, anything else is skipped. Use the route point name upper-cased and truncated to 12.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.583’" (2-digit zero-padded degrees, U+00B0 degree sign, U+2019 minute mark). The A-10 uploader does NOT parse the string: it strips punctuation and types the characters (N4210583 / E04228950), so this exact padded format is mandatory.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "E 042°28.950’" (3-digit zero-padded degrees). The A-10 uploader does NOT parse the string: it strips punctuation and types the characters (N4210583 / E04228950), so this exact padded format is mandatory.

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Ground elevation of the point, integer feet MSL (editor range 0..20000). Typed only when > 0.

fields.label: Time over steerpoint
fields.help: HH:MM:SS or null; route TOT/ETA if the dashboard has one. Shown in the app and kneeboard only, never uploaded on this aircraft.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: True for route target points (shows "TGT" in the list and kneeboard). Not uploaded on this aircraft.

fields.label: Navigation points

options.label: Add to end of the list
Add to end of the first gap

fields.help: SteerpointCaptureMode for captured non-target points. When the waypoint list comes from the dashboard route, leave 0 (append after the route) so captures in the cockpit do not overwrite route points.

fields.label: Target points

options.label: Add to the end of the list

fields.help: SteerpointCaptureMode for captured target points. The UI offers only end-of-list (0) and range (2); 1 is accepted on load but has no radio button. This aircraft has no "Add TGT" capture button, so this rarely matters.

fields.label: Navigation range start
fields.help: First sequence used when Navigation points = Add to specific range. A dashboard can set it to (last route sequence + 1) to keep captures clear of the route.

fields.label: Target range start
fields.help: First sequence used when Target points = Add to specific range.

fields.label: ARC-210 (UHF/VHF/FM)
fields.help: The only radio shown and uploaded.

fields.label: ARC-210 (UHF/VHF/FM) presets
fields.help: Preset channels, Number 1..30, one entry per used channel (null or [] when none). Ordered by Number when uploaded.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset channel number, unique within the radio. Required: RadioPreset has only a Number constructor.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Preset label; the uploader types the first 12 characters (UFC letter mode). Null when empty. Known risk: presets above 18 may land in the wrong slot (paging bug), keep to 1..18 until tested.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: Allowed bands 225.000-399.975 (UHF), 108.000-173.975 (VHF), 30.000-87.975 (FM), 25 kHz steps. Frequencies <= 87.975 are set to FM, others AM. Invariant decimal with exactly 3 decimals, no leading zeros (e.g. "251.000").

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency tuned when Mode = Frequency. Allowed bands 225.000-399.975 (UHF), 108.000-173.975 (VHF), 30.000-87.975 (FM), 25 kHz steps. Frequencies <= 87.975 are set to FM, others AM.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset channel selected when Mode = Preset. Stored as a STRING ("1".."30") or null.

fields.label: Guard
fields.help: Guard receiver. Not offered by the UI for this aircraft and not uploaded; leave false.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 = tune SelectedFrequency, 2 = select SelectedPreset. A new preset has 0 (no combo selection); the uploader then neither tunes nor selects. Set 1 or 2 explicitly.

fields.label: Radio 2 (unused)
fields.help: Hidden in the A-10 UI and never uploaded. Keep the default object.

fields.label: Radio 2 (unused) presets
fields.help: Preset channels, Number 1..30, one entry per used channel (null or [] when none). Ordered by Number when uploaded.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset channel number, unique within the radio. Required: RadioPreset has only a Number constructor.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Unused on the A-10.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: Unused on the A-10. Invariant decimal with exactly 3 decimals, no leading zeros (e.g. "251.000").

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency tuned when Mode = Frequency. Unused on the A-10.

fields.label: Selected preset
fields.help: Preset channel selected when Mode = Preset. Stored as a STRING ("1".."30") or null.

fields.label: Guard
fields.help: Guard receiver. Not offered by the UI for this aircraft and not uploaded; leave false.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 = tune SelectedFrequency, 2 = select SelectedPreset. A new preset has 0 (no combo selection); the uploader then neither tunes nor selects. Set 1 or 2 explicitly.
